versions.changelog:
Initial release of vmflow — Vending Machine Fleet Management Skill.

- Manage vending machine fleets: query sales, inventory, and device health; send credits; trigger firmware and control devices via MQTT RPC and Supabase.
- Dual control planes: Supabase for historical/device data, MQTT for real-time signed commands.
- Sample bash commands and playbooks included for automation and reporting.
- Detailed setup, usage instructions, and data model provided.
- Documents all required environment variables and tools for fleet operators.
